_comment: Portable example. install.ps1 copies it to %USERPROFILE%\.akzo-agent\repos.json (machine-specific, never committed). Set 'path' to the local clone of each repo (e.g. C:\src\my-repo); empty means not configured. 'id' is also the folder name under tasksDir. 'tasksDir' is where refined PBIs go (<tasksDir>\<repo-id>\<PBI-ID>\refined-pbi.md); empty means %USERPROFILE%\.akzo-agent\tasks; it must be absolute (environment variables allowed) and outside Git repositories. Per repo, 'specsDir' (relative to the repo root, e.g. src/.github/specs) puts spec.md and plan.md in <repo>\<specsDir>\<Feature>\ (visible in Git, meant to be committed); empty keeps them beside refined-pbi.md. Per repo, "quality": { "coverage": <percent> } sets the changed-line coverage threshold used when no SonarCloud gate answers (default 80); copy it from the project's SonarCloud quality gate (Coverage on New Code), never guess it. 'commands' must only hold commands verified by running them; record when in 'verified'. 'notes' are hypotheses until 'verified' is filled.
